plan.title: Your best post is already recorded
plan.centralArgument: Founders already say their best ideas out loud; Harmonia turns one recording into a week of grounded content without losing what they meant.

scenes.narration: Every week you explain your product brilliantly. On sales calls, in demos, on podcasts. Then the recording disappears into a folder nobody opens.
scenes.caption: Your best ideas, lost in recordings
scenes.visualPrompt: A dim home office at night, a single desk lamp lighting a stack of unlabeled audio cassettes and a closed laptop, cinematic shallow depth of field, moody blue and amber tones

scenes.narration: So you sit down to write a post from scratch. An hour later you have three sentences, and none of them sound like you.
scenes.caption: Starting from a blank page
scenes.visualPrompt: Close-up of a blank notebook page under harsh morning light, a pen resting across it, a cold cup of coffee beside it, muted grey palette, editorial photography

scenes.narration: Harmonia listens to the recording instead. It finds the moments where you made your point, and keeps your exact words attached to every claim.
scenes.caption: It listens, then keeps your words
scenes.visualPrompt: Abstract visualization of a glowing audio waveform unfurling into ribbons of light that settle into neat cards, deep navy background, warm gold highlights, elegant and calm

scenes.narration: One conversation becomes a clip, a thread, a LinkedIn post, and a newsletter. An editor checks each one before anything goes out.
scenes.caption: One recording, a week of content
scenes.visualPrompt: A single ribbon of light branching into four floating panels of different shapes, tall vertical, square, wide, and folded paper, soft studio lighting, minimalist composition

scenes.narration: You approve what ships. Harmonia does the rest. Record once, and let your ideas keep working all week.
scenes.caption: Record once. Approve. Ship.
scenes.visualPrompt: Sunrise over a city skyline seen through a tall window, a microphone on a stand silhouetted in the foreground, optimistic warm orange light, wide open sky
